description: Check a proposed set of stocks and weights, building nothing: tokens listed and Active, each weight at least the minimum, at most the maximum positions, no duplicates, entries + cash = 10000 bps. With no stocks portfolio yet this OPENS one — a transaction the wallet sends itself, no sign-in — at the address it predicts; otherwise it replaces the portfolio's targets (owner only). Missing CoW approvals are added. Pass `previewId` to `prepare_stock_basket`.

address.description: The wallet that owns, or will own, the stocks portfolio.

name: preview_stock_basket
title: Check proposed stocks targets
